missions.name: Tampa Riverwalk
missions.description: The Riverwalk is experiencing rising visitor volume, mobility bottlenecks, and mixed sentiment from local vendors regarding crowd behavior and pricing pressure.

exploration.brief: As a newly hired Tourism Analyst, you are reviewing the Riverwalk's weekend performance and local stakeholder input. Your recommendation should improve outcomes across visitor experience, local inclusion, and long-term city resilience.
exploration.mediaLabel: Riverwalk flow map and vendor sentiment dashboard
dataPoints: Foot traffic increased 18% in the last quarter.
Local small businesses report uneven customer distribution.
Visitor sentiment is high for events, but complaints mention congestion and litter.

options.title: A) Expand event-driven programming
options.description: Increase headline events and premium hospitality pop-ups to drive immediate spending.
options.feedback: Short-term spending and service visibility improved, but environmental strain intensified with higher peak crowding.

options.title: B) Prioritize green mobility and community co-design
options.description: Invest in transit wayfinding, shade, waste reduction, and local cultural programming partnerships.
options.feedback: Community trust and environmental outcomes improved, though immediate revenue growth softened in the short term.

options.title: C) Launch premium visitor convenience package
options.description: Offer concierge amenities and express services for visitors, funded by selective reallocations.
options.feedback: Visitor convenience rose, but concerns emerged about local inclusivity and ecological pressure.

missions.name: Ybor City Cultural District
missions.description: Nightlife growth is accelerating while heritage groups worry about cultural dilution and resident displacement.

exploration.brief: Your team is asked to create a district strategy that keeps Ybor's identity vibrant while handling late-night surges in demand.
exploration.mediaLabel: Historic district heatmap and event permit timeline
dataPoints: Local artists report reduced access to affordable venues.
Noise complaints increased near mixed-use residential blocks.

options.title: A) Fast-track nightlife expansion licenses
options.description: Approve additional entertainment permits to amplify visitor draw and private investment.
options.feedback: Revenue accelerated, but legacy community trust dropped as nightlife pressure displaced local programming.

options.title: B) Co-fund heritage nights and mobility controls
options.description: Pair curated cultural events with transit controls, safety staffing, and resident listening sessions.
options.feedback: The district retained stronger identity signals and lower friction, even with slightly slower short-term growth.

options.title: C) Introduce premium festival corridor
options.description: Designate a paid-access entertainment corridor with upgraded concierge services.
options.feedback: Visitor service quality improved, but concerns rose about exclusion and cultural authenticity loss.

missions.name: Busch Gardens Visitor Strategy
missions.description: Attendance is climbing, yet queue pressure, transport emissions, and repeat-visitor fatigue are reducing perceived value.

exploration.brief: Leaders need a tactical strategy that supports recurring tourism spend while preserving ecological and community outcomes.
exploration.mediaLabel: Ride capacity dashboard and transport emissions panel
dataPoints: Average queue time climbed by 15 minutes during peak weekends.
Shuttle adoption remains below target at 28%.
Guest surveys cite strong attractions but weak sustainability visibility.

options.title: A) Build high-throughput premium pass lanes
options.description: Scale premium queue lanes and upsell fast-track bundles to maximize park revenue.
options.feedback: Top-line performance improved quickly, but public perception weakened around fairness and environmental pressure.

options.title: B) Launch eco-shuttle + local maker marketplace
options.description: Bundle low-emission transport incentives with rotating local vendor activations.
options.feedback: Operational flow and destination identity both improved, with broad gains across environmental and guest trust metrics.

options.title: C) Focus on social-media thrill campaigns
options.description: Invest in viral campaigns and night events to raise attendance among new audiences.
options.feedback: Attendance rose and guest excitement increased, though system strain and environmental concerns remained unresolved.
